description: This file is the entry point for a React frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM, applies some styling from index.css, and renders the main App component into the DOM's 'root' element within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into a DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM at the specified root.
